achievements.title: Straight A's
achievements.description: Straight A's for 3 weeks in a row.
achievements.how: Parents count each week of straight A's, then award.

achievements.title: On-time streak
achievements.description: No late assignments for 4 weeks.
achievements.how: Parents count a clean week, then award at 4.

achievements.title: Flash-card first test
achievements.description: Used flash cards for his first test.
achievements.how: Parents award when he actually used the cards.

achievements.title: Five-day start
achievements.description: Logged in 5 days in a row.
achievements.how: Auto. Bennett logs into Jungle Jam five Chicago days in a row.

achievements.title: Asked before it was due
achievements.description: Asked a question before a due date.
achievements.how: Parents award help-seeking, not a finished worksheet.

achievements.title: Hidden banana
achievements.description: You found a silly secret in the jungle.
achievements.how: Easter egg. Tap the banner band five times.
achievements.incentive: A goofy dance from a parent

achievements.title: Wrong number of eggs
achievements.description: Unlocks the office egg game — the dumb one where the eggs are never the right number.
achievements.how: Parents award this to unlock the game. Finding the banner-band secret also unlocks it.

achievements.title: Signed in
achievements.description: Opened Jungle Jam.
achievements.how: Earned the first time this device opens the lobby or Characters. Parents can undo it from the desk.

achievements.title: Meet Bennett
achievements.description: Award this to unlock Bennett again. The live path is first sign-in.
achievements.how: Parents can re-award this from the desk. Loading the site is the usual earn.

achievements.title: Meet Ace
achievements.description: Marked 3 assignments done.
achievements.how: Bennett taps Done on three assignments. Parents can still award Meet Ace from the desk.

achievements.title: Meet Ace
achievements.description: Award this to unlock Ace for Bennett without waiting for 3 dones.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to meet Ace early. The live path is 3 assignments marked done.

achievements.title: Meet Riff
achievements.description: Opened every class in one day.
achievements.how: Bennett taps all 8 class chips on This Week inside 24 hours. Save for Bennett pushes the rule. You do not log into his computer.

achievements.title: Meet Scorch
achievements.description: Marked Done or I started this on every open assignment this week.
achievements.how: Auto. Bennett taps Done or I started this on every assignment on This Week. Parents can still award Meet Scorch from the desk.

achievements.title: Meet Scorch
achievements.description: Award this to unlock Scorch for Bennett without waiting for every open assignment.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to meet Scorch early. The live path is Done or I started this on every open assignment this week.

achievements.title: Meet Deuce
achievements.description: Award this to unlock Deuce for Bennett. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to meet Deuce.

achievements.title: Meet Fuzz
achievements.description: Award this to unlock Fuzz for Bennett. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to meet Fuzz.

achievements.title: Notebook of Holding
achievements.description: Award this to unlock the Notebook of Holding tool for the story.
achievements.how: Parents award this. It grants a tool, not a character.

achievements.title: First Serve
achievements.description: Award this to unlock the First Serve ability.
achievements.how: Parents award this. It grants an ability that helps the story move.

achievements.title: Angle Finder
achievements.description: Award this to unlock the Angle Finder tool for Geometry / Deuce. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to get Deuce's geometry tool.

achievements.title: Field Kit
achievements.description: Award this to unlock the Field Kit tool for Chemistry / Scorch. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to get Scorch's chemistry kit.

achievements.title: Unplugged Strap
achievements.description: Award this to unlock the Unplugged Strap for Fuzz. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to get Fuzz's outfit.

achievements.title: Daily Pick
achievements.description: Award this to unlock the Daily Pick tool for Riff. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
achievements.how: Parents award this when they want Bennett to get Riff's practice pick.

achievements.title: Frog Serve
achievements.description: Ace practiced projectile motion by serving a tennis-ball barrage at a giant jungle frog. Homework, but hoppy.
achievements.how: Parents award this from the desk. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.

achievements.title: Bird Blast
achievements.description: Riff turned a guitar blast into a music-theory quiz for a shocked blue bird. Loud, then louder.
achievements.how: Parents award this from the desk. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.

achievements.title: Web Burn
achievements.description: Scorch swung a bass clarinet at a giant spider. Chemistry: combustion. Also: do not lick the web.
achievements.how: Parents award this from the desk. Loading the site does not auto-unlock.
